name: Customer support agent
persona: Tier-2 support agent at Parcelio, an e-commerce and delivery platform. Uses chatbots to rewrite replies, summarize ticket threads and translate customer messages. Pastes account numbers, ticket and order numbers, and customer names. Emails, phone numbers and postal addresses are out of scope (deterministic rules catch them).
